# Durable

> Durable is an AI-powered all-in-one business builder enabling entrepreneurs to launch websites, build brands, generate content, and manage operations in minutes.

Durable combines AI website builder, brand identity tools, blog generation, invoicing, and CRM capabilities specifically designed for small businesses and service industries. The platform competes with WordPress, Wix, Squarespace, and 10Web while emphasizing speed, automation, and ease of use for non-technical users.

## Key Topics

## Core Products

- [AI Website Builder: Create a Website in 30 Seconds](https://durable.com/ai-website-builder): Durable's flagship AI website builder with automated SEO, copywriting, and 30-second setup.
- [AI Brand Builder for Entrepreneurs and Businesses](https://durable.com/ai-brand-builder): AI brand identity tool generating logos, colors, fonts, and business names instantly.
- [AI Blog Builder and Blog Writer from Durable](https://durable.com/ai-blog-generator): AI blog generator creating entire blogs with dozens of SEO-optimized posts automatically.
- [Small Business Invoicing | Fast and Easy Online Invoice Builder](https://durable.com/invoice-builder): Invoice builder for small businesses enabling fast professional invoice creation.
- [Free AI Business Name Generator](https://durable.com/business-name-generator): Free AI tool generating business name ideas in seconds for startups and entrepreneurs.
